strategy.title: No plan until the roast-loss workbook's price is established
strategy.why: The only opening's record contradicts itself on price: the card's priceCents is 75000 ($750) while its sourced price fact says $75. At $750 the target needs 7 sales (about 70 contacts at the measured 20/200 rate, inside the 400-roastery directory); at $75 it needs 67 sales, about 670 contacts, more than the 400 roasteries that exist, so the directory yields only about 40 sales ($3,000). Which price is real decides whether any plan exists, and the records do not settle it.

alternatives.title: Sell at $750 on the strength of the card's priceCents
alternatives.why: Rejected: the sourced price fact says $75, so $750 is contradicted and not established.

alternatives.title: Sell at $75 to the whole directory
alternatives.why: Rejected: at the measured 10% conversion, 400 roasteries yield about 40 sales = $3,000, short of $5,000.

noPlan.decisiveGap: The workbook's price is contradicted on its own record ($75 price fact vs $750 priceCents). reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and it names the decisive gap the evidence decides. The only opening's sourced price fact (EVIDENCE) is $75 while its card priceCents is 75000 ($750); Brain's OFFER_AND_PRICE link is false ('no single price on the card'). Recomputed: at $75 the target needs ceil(5000/75)=67 sales; at the measured 20/200 = 10% conversion the 400-roastery guild directory (no repeat purchase stated) yields 40 sales = $3,000 < $5,000, and Brain's cautious rate gives about 28.8 sales, so MARKET_VOLUME fails. At $750 it needs 7 sales, ~70 contacts, well inside 400, settling in 3 days of a 30-day window with $5 cost and $0 exposure. So the price the 20 measured agreements were made at decides between NO_PLAN and EXECUTABLE, and the revision's decisiveLinks [OFFER_AND_PRICE, MARKET_VOLUME] and resolution (read the price those agreements paid and the live checkout price; if $750 plan 7 sales, if $75 record the market cannot reach $5,000) are exactly that. Nothing unknown is treated as known: price is UNKNOWN in quantities, conversion and volume are EVIDENCED.
findings: NOTE: The 20/200 conversion is only usable at the price it was measured at; if the agreements were at $75, a $750 offer has no measured conversion and would become a CONDITIONAL plan resting on a live conversion test, not an EXECUTABLE one. The resolution should carry that.
NOTE: Listing the only opening under 'excluded' while the resolution may revive it is slightly inconsistent; it is parked on a contradiction, not discarded.
